summary: Humacyte, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 47,619,048 shares of common stock at $1.05 per share, with a 30-day overallotment option for up to 7,142,857 additional shares. The offering is expected to close on June 12, 2026, with net proceeds of approximately $47 million before expenses. Joint book-running managers are Barclays, BTIG, and Titan Partners. This is a routine registered equity offering to raise capital, not a special situation; it does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other event-driven category. The filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
